payload.question: Did the council go ahead with the live budget it proposed?
payload.label: A "live budget" reviewed through 2026/27 rather than fixed in February

target.display: "This year, we're taking a new approach - introducing a real-time live budget that will be reviewed throughout the year to make sure we're spending every pound wisely and where it's needed most." — the council's budget consultation for 2026-2027

payload.evidence: The council proposed a new way of managing its budget for 2026/27, reviewing it during the year instead of setting it once in February, and put it to residents in the budget consultation. This is a proposal the council made in its own words, not a commitment we have found it confirming afterwards. The year does not end until 31 March 2027, so there is nothing to check yet either way. Come back after the outturn report in summer 2027.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
